verification.notes: ESPN confirms Vanessa Bryant spoke by FaceTime on April 4, 2020 after Kobe Bryant was elected to the Hall of Fame. But Kobe died January 26, only about 69 days earlier, not four months; the April appearance reacted to his election, while the formal acceptance on his behalf occurred at the May 2021 enshrinement.
